title: Inspect and extend: Screens, reusable controls, and app shell
objective: Use the real implementation in `App.tsx` to demonstrate and safely improve tab selection, screen composition, action props, and theme tokens.
problem: The shell chooses which room is visible; reusable components and theme tokens keep each room consistent. Trace tabs into screen components, then follow props from shared controls to their event handlers. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `App.tsx` and the related project files: App.tsx; src/screens/FeedScreen.tsx; src/screens/DiscoverScreen.tsx; src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx; src/components.tsx; src/theme.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to tab selection, screen composition, action props, and theme tokens.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: The tabs and suggested feeds are local UI; they are not loaded from a Bluesky server.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: The shell chooses which room is visible; reusable components and theme tokens keep each room consistent. Trace tabs into screen components, then follow props from shared controls to their event handlers.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `App.tsx`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
